methodology: Use filed US S&M only as a broad envelope ceiling, never as media.
Anchor observable media with the 2023 $200M TV/OTT/OOH agency remit, EDO and iSpot TV windows, and current MediaRadar partial coverage.
Exclude sponsorship, promotional incentives, personnel, market research, amortisation, market access, operating costs and the FanDuel Predicts adjusted-EBITDA investment.
Normalize the prior public-source channel shape to the $450M working-media midpoint and retain sports-calendar phasing.
Require the plan and SDE to pass the $200-$450 blended-media-CPA band and 0.9M-2.5M annual-FTD band.
caveats: Inferred public-source envelope; not FanDuel internal data and not an external factual claim.
Channel split and monthly phasing are synthetic planning priors, not verified media-flight data.
Public trackers have different coverage and proprietary estimation methods.
Client finance, media-plan, agency, MMM and platform evidence supersede this baseline.
do_not_claim: $450M is actual, disclosed or verified FanDuel spend.

The $200M-$300M FanDuel Predicts adjusted-EBITDA impact is a media earmark.
Free bets, bonuses, sponsorship rights or operational costs are working media.
